entries.title: Taskbar Title and Desktop shortcuts
entries.lead: Assign a custom taskbar badge per profile and create direct Desktop launch shortcuts from the context menu.

blocks.text: Each profile can now display a custom high-contrast Taskbar Title badge on its browser icon and window title, and right-clicking any profile lets you create a Desktop shortcut that opens that profile directly.

entries.title: High-speed pre-warmed proxy tunnel
entries.lead: Pre-authenticated local connection pooling reduces proxy handshake latency and eliminates UDP retry stalls.

blocks.text: Profiles bound to HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5 proxies now route through a pre-warmed loopback tunnel with TCP_NODELAY and cached geo resolution for faster page loads.
